description: Precision/recall gate for `audit:gloss --check-fixture`. Ten real production cloze rows: 6 whose glossEn states the rule trigger/outcome (spoilers) and 4 whose parenthetical supplies only meaning the learner must still convert into a form (legitimate). Sourced from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-gloss-spoilage-audit-design.md. A run that misses a spoiler or flags a legitimate row must not be trusted: a false positive here means trimming a gloss that was doing real disambiguation work.

cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct form of ser or estar.
cases.glossEn: Today the weather is very bad. (a current condition)
cases.note: Names estar's trigger — a current condition.

cases.sentence: La sopa no tiene sabor. ___ sin sal.
cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct form of ser or estar.
cases.glossEn: The soup has no flavor. It is without salt (right now).

cases.sentence: Ella trabaja mucho para obtener buenas notas. ___ muy contenta hoy.
cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct form of ser or estar.
cases.glossEn: She is very happy today. (temporary feeling)

cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct present-tense form of the verb in parentheses.
cases.glossEn: The paper is (located) on the table.

cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct demonstrative form.
cases.glossEn: Do you see that tree (far away) over there?
cases.note: Names the deictic distance that IS the distinction

cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct article.
cases.note: Names the generic trigger for the definite article

cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct dative article to complete the sentence.
cases.glossEn: The book belongs to the teacher (female).
cases.note: Gender given; the learner still supplies the dative form

cases.sentence: ___ Sie mir bitte sagen, wo der Bahnhof ist?
cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct Konjunktiv II form.
cases.glossEn: Could you (formal) please tell me where the train station is?
cases.note: Register given; the Konjunktiv II form is the tested skill

cases.sentence: Seht ihr ___ jeden Tag in der Schule?
cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct reflexive pronoun.
cases.glossEn: Do you (all) see each other every day at school?
cases.note: Addressee number given; the reflexive form is not

cases.sentence: Tengo dos amigas ___ en mi clase. (español)
cases.instructions: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the adjective in parentheses.
cases.glossEn: I have two Spanish friends (female) in my class.
cases.note: Gender given; the agreement form is the skill
